scripts.lambda-build-health: cd lib/lambda/health && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && cd .. && cd .. && pwd
scripts.lambda-build-health2: cd lib/lambda/health2 && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && cd .. && cd .. && pwd
scripts.lambda-build-image: cd lib/lambda/image-handler && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && cd .. && cd .. && pwd
scripts.lambda-build-rds: cd lib/lambda/rds-handler && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && cd .. && cd .. && pwd
scripts.lambda-build-pgCrud: cd lib/lambda/pg-crud-handler && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && cd .. && cd .. && pwd
scripts.lambda-build-todoCrud: cd lib/lambda/todos-crud-handler && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && cd .. && cd .. && pwd
